title: A surface from a volume (surface-nets)
description: Surface Nets extracts the level surface of a sampled sphere with a sinusoidal ripple. Resolution changes the sampling grid while Level changes the surface.
description_ko: Surface Nets가 물결을 더한 구의 샘플 값에서 등위면을 꺼내요. Resolution은 격자 해상도를, Level은 꺼낼 표면을 바꿔요.
prompt: A surface from a volume. Make the algorithm visible and let the controls change its input.
summary: A surface from a volume. Change the controls to explore the actual algorithm.
summary_ko: 부피에서 꺼낸 표면. 컨트롤을 바꾸며 실제 알고리즘의 결과를 살펴보세요.
try: Change Level to expand the surface
